categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in the chemical and agrochemical industry, with primary business segments including: (1) Agricultural chemical intermediates and active ingredients, particularly dimethyl pentyl amine (DMPA) and related herbicide precursors; (2) Pesticide active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), with dimethyl amylammonium as the flagship product; (3) Pesticide formulations including emulsifiable concentrates and suspension concentrates; and (4) Carbon-5 series chemical products derived from petroleum cracking. The company also engages in agrochemical product trading through its subsidiary Ningbo Jieleke.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous chemical synthesis and automated production technologies. Core technologies include: (1) Low-temperature continuous nitration process for 4-nitro production; (2) Continuous synthesis and purification techniques for dimethyl amylammonium herbicide achieving 98%+ purity with <10ppm nitrosamine impurities; (3) Integrated production of dimethyl pentyl amine from self-produced 4-nitro intermediates; (4) Comprehensive synthesis technology for methoxyfenozide insecticide utilizing dimethyl amylammonium byproducts; (5) Carbon-5 series product processing including selective hydrogenation and catalytic dehydration technologies. Production systems utilize DCS (Distributed Control Systems) for automated process control and quality management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves agrochemical manufacturers and distributors globally. Primary customer types include: (1) International agrochemical corporations such as BASF Corporation, Finchimica S.P.A., and Adama Agan Ltd.; (2) Domestic agricultural chemical companies and distributors in China; (3) Regional agrochemical enterprises in developing markets. End markets include herbicide formulation manufacturers, pesticide distributors, and agricultural input retailers across North America, Europe, Latin America, Africa, and Asia-Pacific regions. The company's products are used in crop protection for cotton, corn, peanuts, garlic, cabbage, rice, and other agricultural crops.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple geographic regions: (1) Domestic operations in China with manufacturing facilities in Zhejiang Province (Shaoxing Shangyu), Jiangsu Province (Lianyungang), and Anhui Province (Tongling); (2) International presence through subsidiaries and partnerships in Latin America (Argentina, Panama, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, Uruguay, Costa Rica, Brazil, Bolivia), North America (Mexico), Africa (Kenya, Ghana, Uganda, Tanzania, Nigeria), Europe (EU, Belarus, Georgia), and Asia (Bangladesh, Indonesia). Approximately 71% of 2023 revenue derived from overseas markets, with significant export operations to developed and emerging agricultural markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream: Production of chemical intermediates (4-nitro, 3-nitro, 3-amine, pentamine) from basic petrochemical feedstocks; (2) Midstream: Synthesis of pesticide active pharmaceutical ingredients (dimethyl amylammonium, methoxyfenozide) from intermediates; (3) Downstream: Formulation of pesticide products into commercial formulations (emulsifiable concentrates, suspension concentrates, microencapsulated suspensions). Additionally, through subsidiary Ningbo Jieleke, the company engages in agrochemical product trading and distribution, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and distributor in the agricultural chemical value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Consolidating market leadership in dimethyl amylammonium herbicide through continuous process optimization and cost reduction; (2) Expanding into carbon-5 specialty chemicals through the Tongling green new materials project, targeting high-value products including pentanone series, pentene, and cyclopentene; (3) Developing new pesticide active ingredients including benzoxazinone herbicide and benzofenone fungicide; (4) Advancing production automation and digitalization through DCS systems and smart factory initiatives; (5) Pursuing international market expansion and agrochemical product registration in emerging markets; (6) Implementing green chemistry and environmental protection improvements across manufacturing processes. R&D investments totaled 40.03 million yuan in 2023, representing 5.73% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of chemical and agrochemical products. Revenue streams include: (1) Direct sales of pesticide active pharmaceutical ingredients (dimethyl amylammonium, methoxyfenozide) to agrochemical manufacturers and distributors; (2) Sales of chemical intermediates (4-nitro, pentamine, 3-nitro, 3-amine) to downstream chemical manufacturers; (3) Sales of pesticide formulations (emulsifiable concentrates, suspension concentrates) to agrochemical companies and distributors; (4) Sales of carbon-5 series chemical products to specialty chemical customers; (5) Trading revenue from agrochemical products through subsidiary Ningbo Jieleke. The company employs both direct sales to major customers and distribution through trading partners, with approximately 92% of 2023 revenue from direct sales and 8% from distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading supplier of dimethyl amylammonium herbicide intermediates and active ingredients in China, with approximately 50% domestic market share in dimethyl amylammonium production. The company competes with international agrochemical corporations (BASF, Bayer, Corteva, Syngenta) in the global market, though these competitors primarily focus on formulation and marketing rather than active ingredient production. Domestically, the company faces competition from other Chinese agrochemical manufacturers. The company's competitive advantages include: (1) Full supply chain integration from intermediates to formulations; (2) Advanced continuous production technology achieving superior product purity; (3) Cost competitiveness through integrated production; (4) Established relationships with international agrochemical corporations; (5) Expanding global distribution network through Ningbo Jieleke subsidiary.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical manufacturer with significant growth trajectory. 2023 financial metrics: Revenue of 699.19 million yuan (down 8.97% from 768.07 million yuan in 2022); Net profit attributable to parent company of 88.41 million yuan (down 42.17% from 152.88 million yuan in 2022); Total assets of 2.92 billion yuan (up 39.17% from 2.10 billion yuan in 2022); Shareholders' equity of 1.67 billion yuan (up 4.18% from 1.61 billion yuan in 2022). The 2023 revenue decline reflects industry-wide demand weakness and inventory destocking, while asset growth reflects acquisition of Ningbo Jieleke and capital investments in the Tongling carbon-5 project. The company maintains strong profitability with 35.21% gross margin and 5.40% return on equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Superior product quality: Dimethyl amylammonium herbicide achieving 98%+ purity with nitrosamine content <10ppm, meeting stringent international standards (EU 40ppm, US 10ppm); (2) Cost leadership: Integrated full-chain production from basic chemicals to formulations enables significant cost advantages over competitors; (3) Supply chain reliability: Vertical integration ensures consistent quality, stable supply, and reduced transaction costs for customers; (4) Environmental sustainability: Focus on low-toxicity, environmentally-friendly herbicides replacing legacy products like acetochlor and trifluralin; (5) Technical expertise: Advanced continuous synthesis and purification technologies developed through sustained R&D investment; (6) Global market access: Extensive overseas product registrations (965+ registrations across 40+ countries) and established distribution networks through Ningbo Jieleke subsidiary enabling rapid market entry for customers.
